info.en:
These maps were created using data from the 2021 census of Greece, available from the Hellenic Statistical Authority (ELSTAT) (statistics.gr) (table A1602_SAM03_TB_DC_00_2021_C01_F_GR, permanent population by sex and age group, from the whole country down to settlements).
The Greek census does not ask about ethnicity or religion, so only the population mode is available for Greece. Selecting a mode that needs ethnic or religious data would show every area as “No data”, so these modes are hidden.
Boundaries are from geoBoundaries and still show the municipalities as they were before the 2019 reform, which split a few of them. In those cases the new municipalities are added together on one area: Corfu (Central Corfu and the Diapontian Islands, North Corfu, South Corfu), Cephalonia (Argostoli, Lixouri, Sami), Lesbos (Mytilene, West Lesbos), Samos (East Samos, West Samos), Servia-Velventos (Servia, Velventos) and Mylopotamos (Mylopotamos, Anogeia). The “Select area” tool lists the individual census municipalities of each regional unit.
The 13,586 settlements have no boundaries, so they appear only in the “Select area” tool, under their municipality. Mount Athos is an autonomous region, shown here as a regional unit of Central Macedonia as in the census table. Settlement figures may differ by a few hundred people from the municipal totals, and the municipalities add up to 23 fewer people than the national total.
